Optional reference data and licenses

Source: vignettes/reference-data.Rmd
reference-data.Rmd

Install the code, then choose the data

ldfreq’s code is MIT licensed and its installation contains no third-party reference datasets. Core lexical-diversity measures, your own reference tables, concordances and study tables work without downloading these resources. The adapted TUBELEX tokenizer example retains its BSD-3-Clause code notice.

Resource name Use Separate terms Download
tubelex English frequency/prevalence profiles BSD-3-Clause 2.56 MB
nj8 New JACET 8000 rank/level profiles JACET permission and attribution 0.05 MB
morpholex English morphological worksheets CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 1.34 MB
bnccoca Nation’s Level 6 word families CC BY-SA 4.0 0.52 MB
morphynet Nine example derivational relations CC BY-SA 3.0 0.01 MB

The terms apply to the corresponding data. For example, obtaining MorphoLex through a separate download does not remove its noncommercial restriction. Installing or using the independent MIT code does not require MorphoLex.

Inspect first, download explicitly 

lexdiv_resource_info("morpholex")[c("resource", "version", "license",
  "license_url", "notice_url", "download_bytes")]
#>    resource  version         license
#> 1 morpholex 5bc425fb CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0
#>                                          license_url
#> 1 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/
#>                                                                                   notice_url
#> 1 https://github.com/Ryuya-dot-com/ldfreq/blob/v0.4.0.9006/inst/licenses/morpholex/NOTICE.md
#>   download_bytes
#> 1        1336656

Open the license and notice links and confirm that the terms fit your intended use. Select only the resources you need. No download happens unless you make this call with accept_license = TRUE:

lexdiv_download_resources("tubelex", accept_license = TRUE)
# Or select several resources after reviewing each one's terms:
lexdiv_download_resources(c("nj8", "bnccoca"), accept_license = TRUE)

The downloader verifies the fixed archive and every member before making the cache available. Normal reads verify the required file and do not contact the network. A previously verified resource is reused.

tubelex_profile(c("student", "learn", "unfamiliar"))
nj8_profile(c("student", "learn", "unfamiliar"))
morpholex_data(sheets = "All roots")  # requires the separate morpholex resource
bnccoca_data()

Choose a cache location or work offline 

options(ldfreq.resource_dir = "/path/to/my/reference-cache")
lexdiv_download_resources("tubelex", accept_license = TRUE)
lexdiv_resource_info("tubelex")

Alternatively set LDFREQ_RESOURCE_DIR before starting R. Without either setting, the cache is under tools::R_user_dir("ldfreq", "cache"). It sits outside the package library, so reinstalling the package does not erase it. A different pinned resource version gets a different subdirectory.

For an offline computer, copy the complete cache from a machine where you explicitly obtained it under the applicable terms, then select that cache location. Include the license and provenance files. A partial or modified cache is rejected. Inspect the returned path, remove that specific version directory if you intend to replace it, and explicitly download again.

Update from 0.4.x

Earlier versions bundled these snapshots. In 0.5.0.9001 their data bytes and resource identities are unchanged, but they are stored separately. Calls such as nj8_profile() without a supplied word list now require the explicit cache setup above. Existing saved results remain readable. Caller-supplied word lists and reference tables continue to work without downloads.

Record the resource version, source hash, coverage and citation with your results. citation("ldfreq") cites the package; it does not replace citations for the data and measurement methods.
